wargearItems.name: Markerlight
effects: A Markerlight is a Ranged weapon that generates zero damage but confers the following ability when fired:
Target Acquisition: Markerlights that successfully Hit an enemy unit provide stacking, cumulative abilities for other friendly T'au units that make Ranged attacks against that enemy unit, as follows:
1 to 5 Markerlight Hits: friendly T'au units add 1 to their Hit roll
6 to 10 Markerlight Hits: The above applies, and friendly T'au units increase their Ballistic Skill by 1
11 or more Markerlight Hits: The above applies, and friendly T'au ranged attacks (excluding attacks made by Ordnance or One Shot weapons) increase their Attacks characteristic by 1.

If an Infantry model chooses to make a Ranged attack with a Markerlight, and that attack successfully Hits, it can only make that Ranged attack as part of its Activation; no other Ranged attacks can be made by that model.
A Markerlight's effect lasts until the end of the Battle Round, or until the bearer of the Markerlight is destroyed.

wargearItems.name: Shield Generator
effects: The bearer increases its Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks, and gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ and Bodyguard abilities.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer increases its Toughness characteristic by 3 against Ranged attacks, and gains the Invulnerable Save 5+ and Bodyguard abilities.

wargearItems.name: Pulse Accelerator
effects: Increase the Range characteristic by 6" and Armour Piercing characteristic by 1 when all models in the unit equipped with the following Pulse weapons target the same enemy unit: Pulse Pistol, Pulse Carbine, Pulse Rifle, Long-shot Pulse Rifle, Pulse Cannon, Heavy Pulse Cannon.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Increase the Range characteristic by 6" and Armour Piercing characteristic by 1 when all models in the unit equipped with the following Pulse weapons target the same enemy unit: Pulse Pistol, Pulse Carbine, Pulse Rifle, Long-shot Pulse Rifle, Pulse Cannon, Heavy Pulse Cannon.

wargearItems.name: Early Warning Override
effects: The bearer increases its Ballistic Skill by 1 when targeting enemy units that used the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action within 12" of the bearer during the current Battle Round.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer increases its Ballistic Skill by 1 when targeting enemy units that used the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves Action within 12" of the bearer during the current Battle Round.

wargearItems.name: Counterfire Defence System
effects: Reduce the Attacks characteristic of incoming Ranged attacks against the bearer's unit by D3 (to a minimum of 1). This wargear has no effect against Ranged attacks with the Torrent keyword.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Reduce the Attacks characteristic of incoming Ranged attacks against the bearer's unit by D3 (to a minimum of 1). This wargear has no effect against Ranged attacks with the Torrent keyword.

wargearItems.name: Velocity Tracker
effects: The bearer's Ranged weapons gain the Anti Air ability.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer's Ranged weapons gain the Anti Air ability.

wargearItems.name: Multi-Tracker
effects: The bearer scores Critical Hits on a 5+ when making a Ranged attack in the same activation that began with using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves or Move Actions.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer scores Critical Hits on a 5+ when making a Ranged attack in the same activation that began with using the Enter the Battlefield from Strategic Reserves or Move Actions.

wargearItems.name: Stim Injectors
effects: The bearer gains the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. Once per battle when the unit is the target of an enemy attack, you can choose to have the bearer drain its Stims. When it does do, the Damage characteristic of enemy attacks is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1), and, if the bearer is still on the battlefield in your next Command Phase, it can regain up to D3 lost Wounds. After choosing to drain its Stims, this wargear upgrade confers no further abilities to its bearer.

wargearItems.name: Stealth Field Projector
effects: The unit gains the Stealth ability, or decreases the range of an existing Stealth ability from 12" to 6".
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The unit gains the Stealth ability, or decreases the range of an existing Stealth ability from 12" to 6".

wargearItems.name: Target Lock
effects: The bearer's weapons gain the Assault ability. This wargear has no effect on weapons that already possess the Assault ability, or which possess the Ordnance keyword.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer's weapons gain the Assault ability. This wargear has no effect on weapons that already possess the Assault ability, or which possess the Ordnance keyword.

wargearItems.name: Advanced Targeting System
effects: The bearer scores Critical Wounds on a 5+ when making Ranged attacks.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: The bearer scores Critical Wounds on a 5+ when making Ranged attacks.

wargearItems.name: XV26 Stealth Suit
effects: The bearer:
Gains the Stealth keyword
Reduces its Movement characteristic by 2"
Reduces its Toughness characteristic by 2
Reduces its Wounds characteristic by 1
Models equipped with a XV26 Stealth Suit do not select Ranged and Melee weapon options detailed under their unit's Wargear Options, and must make selections as detailed below.
Each model must be equipped with 1 of the following Battlesuit Hardpoint Wargear:
Flamer
Pulse Cannon
Plasma Rifle
Fusion Blaster
Each model must be equipped with 1 of the following Battlesuit Hardpoint Wargear:
Markerlight
Shield Generator
Velocity Tracker
Multi-Tracker
Target Lock
Advanced Targeting System
Any eligible weapon equipped by a Leader model equipped with a XV26 Stealth Suit can be upgraded to an Experimental Weapons System.
Leader models equipped with a XV26 Stealth Suit can only Lead the following units: Stealth Team.

Ranged Torrent weapons instead increase their Strength and Attacks characteristic by 2 and gain the Poison 1 ability, but gain the Heavy ability reduce their Range characteristic by 3".

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
